# Protein-ligand Docking tutorials using BioExcel Building Blocks (biobb): Nextflow

Nextflow version of the [python workflow](../python/workflow.py), with the [BioBB Nextflow modules](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_adapters/tree/master/biobb_adapters/nextflow) it uses copied in `modules/`. Every step runs the BioBB block inside its biocontainer (or bioconda package) with the properties of [python/workflow.yml](../python/workflow.yml).

## Run

From a clone of this repository, with [Nextflow](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/install.html) >=25.10.0 and Docker:

```bash
nextflow run biobb_wf_virtual-screening_fpocket/nextflow -profile docker
```

Profiles: `docker`, `apptainer`, `singularity` and `conda`. Results are written to `results/<id>/<step>/` (`-output-dir` to change it), with files named `<id>_<step>_<role>.<ext>`.

## Inputs

`samplesheet.csv` (`--input`): one row per system, all of them run in parallel. Paths are absolute or relative to the samplesheet folder. The default samplesheet runs the inputs of the python workflow.

| Column | Python workflow input | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | | Name of the run, prefix of the output files |
| `all_pockets` | `all_pockets.zip` | step1_fpocket_select |
| `ligand` | `ligand.pdb` | step3_babel_convert_prep_lig |
| `protein` | `protein.pdb` | step4_str_check_add_hydrogens |

## Configuration

`nextflow.config` has the BioBB properties (`ext.properties`) and output extensions (`ext.outputs`) of every step. Change them there or in a config file given with `-c`.

## Steps

| Step | Block | Description |
|---|---|---|
| step1_fpocket_select | [biobb_vs/fpocket_select](modules/bioexcel/biobb_vs/fpocket_select/README.md) | Extract pocket cavity |
| step2_box | [biobb_vs/box](modules/bioexcel/biobb_vs/box/README.md) | Generating cavity box |
| step3_babel_convert_prep_lig | [biobb_chemistry/babel_convert](modules/bioexcel/biobb_chemistry/babel_convert/README.md) | Preparing small molecule (ligand) for docking |
| step4_str_check_add_hydrogens | [biobb_structure_utils/str_check_add_hydrogens](modules/bioexcel/biobb_structure_utils/str_check_add_hydrogens/README.md) | Preparing target protein for docking |
| step5_autodock_vina_run | [biobb_vs/autodock_vina_run](modules/bioexcel/biobb_vs/autodock_vina_run/README.md) | Running the docking |
| step6_babel_convert_pose_pdb | [biobb_chemistry/babel_convert](modules/bioexcel/biobb_chemistry/babel_convert/README.md) | Converting ligand pose to PDB format |
